name: Unit test suite
about: Write pytest coverage for an existing module, including edge cases.
title: Write unit tests for {module}
description:
Add pytest coverage for {module}.
Cover the happy path, error paths and at least two edge cases.
Use fixtures, not module-level mutable state.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the current implementation of {module}
When pytest runs tests/test_{module}.py
Then all tests pass
And every public function has at least one test
And failure modes (exceptions, empty input) are covered
